thread_text:
mario g: Heads up — the onboarding KB page /kb/onboarding/getting-started is returning a 404 for some links (seen during the new hires flow)...

jess chen: oof, saw that earlier :/ which link specifically?

mario g: the 'Set up local dev' link points to https://internal.redwood.com/docs/dev/setup (404)

alex r: i think that path was moved during the docs reorganize last week. quick check: the new path is /docs/dev/environment

mario g: thanks — can we either add a redirect or update the anchor? new hires are blocked on this step.

jess chen: i can update the KB tonight. pinging owners to confirm redirect vs update — @samir @lina p

samir: prefer redirect if possible, keeps old links intact for search. who has access to the CDN redirects?

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: docs-redirects/2026-03-18T02:00Z (manual approval required)

lina p: i'll approve if it's a small redirect. + can jess add a one-line note in the KB mentioning the moved doc so folks know where to look?

jess chen: yep — i'll do both. plan:
1) add 301 redirect from /docs/dev/setup -> /docs/dev/environment
2) update KB anchor to new path and add note "moved from /docs/dev/setup"

alex r: FYI for ops: redirect map lives in infra/config/cdn-redirects.yaml. quick patch:
```yaml
- from: "/docs/dev/setup"
  to: "/docs/dev/environment"
  code: 301
```

mario g: perfect, thanks everyone. jess — can you drop the PR link here when ready? :eyes:

jess chen: PR created: https://git.internal.redwood.com/redwood/docs/pulls/4321 — includes redirect + KB edit. requesting review from @alex r

alex r: reviewing now. small nit on wording but otherwise lgtm. :thumbsup:

jess chen: merged and deploy approved by @lina p. deploy-bot shows success.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: docs-redirects v1.2.3 — status: success

mario g: confirmed link works from the new hire flow. closing the issue. thanks all! :tada:
